title: Birla Corporation reports second-quarter results for 2027 financial year
content: India: Birla Corporation has reported revenues of US$250m for the second quarter of the 2027 financial year, up by 9.5% year-on-year. Net profit fell by 59% to US$3.9m, compared with US$9.5m in the corresponding quarter of the previous year. Earnings before interest, taxation, depreciation and amortisation (EBITDA) declined by 25% to US$23.9m, down from US$32.1m previously.
